name: Typographic Window Reveal
summary: Giant numerals fill the frame and act as windows onto the product; scene changes dive through a glyph's counter.
look: Deep ink background with edge-to-edge Manrope 800 numerals and words used as clip masks; light dashboard tiles and the live metric chart play inside the letterforms while counters stay dark. A thin offset outline echoes each glyph, and all facts sit in small mono captions.

components.name: Mask glyph
components.role: 340–900 px black-weight type as an SVG clipPath window

components.name: Inner scene
components.role: product UI (dashboard tiles, the metric chart) playing inside the glyph

components.name: Counter portal
components.role: the hole of a 0 / 8 / % used as the tunnel between scenes

components.name: Stroke echo
components.role: offset 3 px outline of the glyph, teal normally, coral for the anomaly

components.name: Corner caption
components.role: small mono lines carrying the facts the glyph can't

components.name: Numeral lockup
components.role: the closing '0' holding the product beside tagline and CTA

motion.name: Zoom-through
motion.how: mask scale 1 → 40 into a counter, power4.in 700 ms, cutting on the drop or a downbeat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Parallax interior
motion.how: inner scene drifts at 0.3× opposite to the glyph, linear

motion.name: Glyph swap
motion.how: one numeral clip-wipes to the next (38 → 0) in 250 ms on the downbeat

story: Hook: a giant '38' filled with a mosaic of dashboard tiles — 'DASHBOARDS OPEN RIGHT NOW · 3 CHECKED' — and 'How many did you check today?'. Reveal: we dive through a counter and land on the drop inside a giant 'Pulse' with a white pulse line and coral dot running through the letters, the Acme mark and name above. Proof: the checkout chart scrolls inside a giant '−18%' and turns coral at the drop; captions carry 'since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', 'Pulse caught it. Your call.' with Roll back / Acknowledge. CTA: the product sits inside a giant '0' (customers who noticed) beside 'Caught before customers noticed.', lockup and Start free.
adapt: Pick the three numbers that tell your story (a pain count, your key metric, a zero) and put screen recordings or UI mock-ups inside them; keep the real data in captions.

references.note: text reveal and mask animation techniques

fit.risk: UI inside the letters is not readable as UI; every fact must also appear in a caption

best_for: any product with one hero number
